question: What regression cases and visibility boundaries must the repair preserve?

criteria.instruction: Test NULL-containing, empty and duplicate completion sets; identical IDs across projects; inactive items; pagination over eligible pending rows. Empty completion sets allow eligible items, duplicates do not change existence, game rows never appear in lab listing and game completion cannot suppress lab work. Preserve unlinked imports for authorized review and distinguish query failure/unknown from proven completion.
Ground coverage in Q18 and pending repair review, using selected cross-project ID 2 as the concrete boundary case.
Do not claim an approved migration/deletion or completed production rollout and do not expose unrelated project records.
